verdict.rationale: Thoropass docs describe a dedicated access-review workflow that reminds admins per policy timelines, validates access changes before completion, and automates evidence gathering for audits, with 'Head Start' reuse of prior review data and up-to-95% workload reduction for recurring reviews across connected systems (thoropass-docs-4,5,30,31,32,53). This matches the story's core: periodic reviews, in-app completion/validation, and evidence flowing into the audit evidence pipeline. Missing for 10: explicit UI proof of reviewer 'sign-off' action, explicit confirmation the review artifact is stored in a named 'evidence library' object, and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
